function P(px, py, pz) { var x = px - 0.5, y = py - 0.5, z = pz - 0.5; var cy = Math.cos(yaw), sy = Math.sin(yaw); var x1 = x * cy + z * sy, z1 = -x * sy + z * cy; var cx = Math.cos(pitch), sx = Math.sin(pitch); var y2 = y * cx - z1 * sx; return [CX + x1 * SCALE, CY - y2 * SCALE]; }

['X', 'Y', 'Z'].forEach(function (key) { var d = AXIS_D[key]; var o = P(0, 0, 0), t = P(d[0], d[1], d[2]); setLine(axLine[key], o, t); var dx = t[0] - o[0], dy = t[1] - o[1]; var L = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) || 1; var ux = dx / L, uy = dy / L, px = -uy, py = ux; var bx = t[0] - ux * 11, by = t[1] - uy * 11; axArrow[key].setAttribute('points', t[0].toFixed(1) + ',' + t[1].toFixed(1) + ' ' + (bx + px * 5.5).toFixed(1) + ',' + (by + py * 5.5).toFixed(1) + ' ' + (bx - px * 5.5).toFixed(1) + ',' + (by - py * 5.5).toFixed(1)); axLabel[key].setAttribute('x', (t[0] + ux * 30).toFixed(1)); axLabel[key].setAttribute('y', (t[1] + uy * 30 + 4).toFixed(1)); }); }
function loop() { if (!dragging && !hovering) yaw += SPEED; frame(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }
